import json, re, random, sys, time
import chess

RULES = json.load(open("re.json"))


def run(fen):
    for p, r in RULES:
        fen = re.sub(p, r, fen)
    return fen.split("\n")


def ref(fen):
    b = chess.Board(fen)
    out = set()
    for m in b.legal_moves:
        if m.promotion and m.promotion != chess.QUEEN:
            continue
        c = b.copy(); c.push(m)
        out.add(" ".join(c.fen().split(" ")[:-2]))
    return out


def check(fen):
    ours = [" ".join(x.split(" ")[:-2]) for x in run(fen)]
    exp = ref(fen)
    ok = len(ours) == len(exp) and len(set(ours)) == len(ours) and all(
        x in exp or x.rpartition(" ")[0] + " -" in exp for x in ours)
    if not ok:
        print("FAIL", fen)
        print(" extra", [x for x in ours if x not in exp and x.rpartition(" ")[0] + " -" not in exp])
        print(" missing", exp - set(ours) - {x.rpartition(" ")[0] + " -" for x in ours})
        sys.exit(1)


sample = "<REDACTED_B64> w kq - 0 1"
print(run(sample))
random.seed(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 0)
n = 0
t = time.time()
for g in range(int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 200):
    b = chess.Board()
    while not b.is_game_over() and b.ply() < 300:
        if b.turn == chess.WHITE and any(True for _ in b.legal_moves):
            check(b.fen()); n += 1
        moves = list(b.legal_moves)
        # bias toward captures/pawn moves for variety
        b.push(random.choice(moves))
print("ok", n, "positions", (time.time() - t) / n, "s/pos")
